1THE CASTE DISABILITIES REMOVAL
(WEST PAKISTAN AMENDMENT) ACT, 1963
(W.P. Act X of 1963)
[12th July, 1963]
An Act to amend the Caste Disabilities Removal Act,
1850, in its application to the Province of West Pakistan.
Preamble. WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Caste
Disabilities Removal Act, 1850, in its application to the
Province of West Pakistan in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows―
Short title and 1. (1) This Act may be called the Caste Disabilities
extent. Removal (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1963.
(2) It shall extend to the whole of West Pakistan
except the Tribal Areas.
Amendment of 2. The full stop at the end of section 1 of the Caste
section 1 of Disabilities Removal Act, 1850, shall be replaced by a colon
Act XXI of
and thereafter the following proviso shall be added:―
1850.
"Provided that nothing contained in this Act shall apply
to the rights of inheritance to the property of a Muslim.”
